Review pass done. I found nothing to fix, so I changed nothing.

**What I checked:**
- **Scope:** this attempt's three commits (`d819bf5`, `165089e`, `5d0c632`) change only `src/main.js`, `src/game.js` and `test/frost.test.js`, and all three are in the triage's `touches:`. Compared with `origin/main`, every changed source and test file is in `touches:`. No commit from this attempt writes under `docs/changes/`.
- **Removed `spawnTimer` accessor:** nothing in `src` or `test` still refers to it.
- **Tests can fail:**
  - The new test that sends a frost hit through `step` compares the hit ghost against an unhit ghost by equality. If `step` stopped slowing the ghost, the two would move the same distance and the test would go red.
  - The test that starts the real `main.js` would go red in two cases. If `main.js` passed no kind to `draw`, the frames after keys 3 and 1 would equal the bare HUD. If it passed `LANTERN` from boot, the first frame would already carry an extra label.
  - Its "names none before a pick" half has no assertion of its own. It is covered only by the case above, which turns red if `main.js` hands `draw` a kind at boot, so I left it.
- **Prose against code:** the comments on `kind` and `picked` in `src/main.js` match how the code behaves, given that `kindForKey` maps keys 1, 2 and 3 to lantern, brazier and frost.
- **Values written twice:** none. The tests build the expected labels from `FROST.name`, `FROST.cost`, `LANTERN.name` and `LANTERN.cost` rather than restating them.

**Checks:** `node --test test/frost.test.js` passes 9 of 9. `npm --prefix . run test` passes 125 tests with 0 failing. This clone has no Makefile, so the line's checks are the `node --test` runs. The working tree is clean.
